William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Songs from ‘An Island in The Moon’

II. Honour and Genius is all I ask

H
ONOUR
 and Genius is all I ask,
And I ask the Gods no more!
No more! No more![
the three Philosophers bear chorus.
No more! No more!
